detail:
--- page 1 ---
Nemotron 3 launch notes (December 2025)
Personal notes, written after the launch announcement. Not an official document.
Nemotron 3 is NVIDIA’s open model family: hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts,
long context, open weights and open training data.
Nano (30B total, about 3B active) is available now. Fast and cheap -- good for agent
tool calls.
Super (about 100B) and Ultra (about 500B) were announced but are NOT available yet.
Expected sometime in the first half of 2026.
Plan for Mark II: run everything on Nano for now, including planning. Switch planning to
Super when it ships. Ultra is probably out of reach for this project.
Open questions: Will Ultra be served on any hosted API, or self-host only? How much will
the bigger models cost per million tokens?

--- page 1 ---
Token Factory setup notes
Personal notes on setting up Nebius Token Factory. Not an official document.
OpenAI-compatible API. Use the openai Python SDK with base URL
https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/ and an API key in NEBIUS_API_KEY.
Nano pricing when I checked: roughly $0.06 per million input tokens.
To check: which Nemotron 3 models are on Token Factory today, and what Super and Ultra
cost. Also whether there is a spending limit -- I do not want surprise charges.

# Nemotron 3 on Nebius Token Factory — Availability & Pricing (as of 2026-10-14)

**Bottom line:** Your launch notes (Dec 2025) expected Super and Ultra in H1 2026. **Both are live on Token Factory today.** Nano, Super, Ultra, and Lightning are all available via the OpenAI-compatible API.

---

## Current Model Catalogue (Token Factory live)

| Model ID | Active Params | Context | Input $/1M | Output $/1M | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B` | ~3B | 262K | **$0.06** | **$0.24** | Fast, cheap; good for agent tool calls [1][2][3] |
| `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning` | — | — | **$0.06** | **$0.24** | Same price tier as Nano; generally available |
| `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b` | 12B | 1M | **$0.30** | **$0.90** | Hybrid MoE, multi-agent & complex reasoning [5] |
| `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | — | 1M | **$1.00** | **$3.00** | Frontier reasoning, 5× faster inference for agentic workloads [1][4] |

**Source of truth:** Token Factory live catalogue (authoritative; I am running on it right now). Web listings [1][2][3][4][5] match.

---

## What Your Notes Got Wrong / Outdated

| Your Note | Reality |
|---|---|
| "Super and Ultra … NOT available yet. Expected sometime in the first half of 2026." | **Both shipped.** Ultra announced live 2026-06-04 [4]; Super blog post confirms availability [5]. |
| "Ultra is probably out of reach for this project." | Ultra is **hosted on Token Factory** at $1/$3 per 1M — no self-host required. |
| "Nano pricing when I checked: roughly $0.06 per million input tokens." | Correct. Also $0.24 output [1][2][3]. |
| "Whether there is a spending limit — I do not want surprise charges." | Not documented in gathered sources. Check Token Factory dashboard / billing settings for hard caps. |

---

## Quick Comparison for Mark II Planning

| Use Case | Recommended Model | Cost per 1M tokens (in+out) |
|---|---|---|
| High-volume tool calls, routing, lightweight agents | Nano / Lightning | $0.30 |
| Multi-agent orchestration, long-horizon planning | Super | $1.20 |
| Deep research, coding agents, frontier reasoning | Ultra | $4.00 |

---

## API Access

- **Base URL:** `https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/`
- **Auth:** `NEBIUS_API_KEY` (OpenAI SDK compatible)
- **Model IDs:** Use the exact IDs in the table above.

---

## Sources

1. **Mastra Docs — Nebius Token Factory Models: IDs, Pricing & Usage** — https://mastra.ai/models/providers/nebius  
2. **OpenRouter — Nebius Token Factory Models** — https://openrouter.ai/provider/nebius

4. **Nebius on X (2026-06-04) — "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is now live on Nebius Token Factory"** — https://x.com/nebiusai/status/2062531459647226181  
5. **Nebius Blog — "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super now available on Nebius Token Factory"** — https://nebius.com/blog/posts/nemotron3-super-now-available
